name: DTMAPI 更多存档
author: DTMAPI
description: DTMAPI experimental 更多存档槽。通过官方存档 UI 和 LocalSave 路径扩展存档槽数量，不改动存档格式。

localized_description.schinese: 扩展官方存档界面显示的本地存档槽数量。前六个槽位保持原版兼容；禁用后不会删除额外存档文件。
localized_description.tchinese: 擴展官方存檔介面顯示的本地存檔槽數量。前六個槽位保持原版相容；停用後不會刪除額外存檔檔案。
localized_description.english: Expands the number of local save slots shown by the official save UI. The first six slots remain vanilla-compatible, and disabling the mod does not delete extra archive files.
